page.overview:
Who is Anakiss?

Anakiss physical features are similar to Anasui, but his clothes have been replaced by a jacket and long brim hat with a feather on it.

Presumably not as maniacal as Anasui due to not being a convict, Anakiss is a typical carefree man who is in a relationship with his girlfriend, Irene. He appears friendly enough to offer strangers a ride when it's raining.

After the universe is reset due to Made in Heaven, Emporio Alniño defeats Pucci and is transported to a random gas station. There he meets several alternate universe counterpoint's of his friends, including Anakiss and his girlfriend, Irene, as well as Eldis. Soon after Emporio misses the bus, Irene offers Eldis and him a ride. Eldis declines at first, but soon after the rain starts up, Anakiss says he will wait to see how well she does waiting for the bus in the rain. Irene explains that they were on their way to meet with Irene's father in order to ask for his approval of her marriage with Anakiss. Emporio and Eldis eventually accept the offer and the group drives off, but not before Irene tells Anakiss to stop the car to give a ride to what appears to be an Alternate Weather Report walking on the side of the road.
